texts: Write a doha about a clay lamp made by a potter that gives light only because of the fire it is near, showing how a person becomes bright by staying close to the wise and good.
Since my potter friend began spending evenings with the village elders, he has become noticeably wiser, like a clay lamp that catches its glow from others.
The potter's lamp is only clay until it sits beside a flame; so is a man until he sits beside the good.
potter, lamp, good company
doha: the clay lamp & potter, who you hang around with matters
fish, well, company
doha: a fish in a well shaped by who it lives with
I grew up in a tiny village among people who never aimed higher, and a few years in the city with ambitious friends changed me completely, like a fish moved from a well to a wide river.
The fish in the well is shaped by the water around it, and the heart by the company it keeps.
Compose a doha about a fish living in a well, whose life is shaped by the company it keeps and the water it swims in, a picture of how our associates determine what we become, for better or worse.
Beads alone are scattered; strung together they are a prayer: so is a soul among the good.
doha: prayer beads strung together, like good friends
Write a doha about prayer beads that gain their meaning only when strung together, a picture of how a person finds purpose and goodness when he keeps the company of fellow seekers and the wise.
I joined a small prayer group last year, with our beads in hand, and I noticed my own habits changing without any effort; it's the first time I've understood why people say stay near good people.
prayer beads, good company
doha: the moth becomes what it follows, so choose your company
Write a doha about a moth that follows whatever bright thing is nearest, and about how a person likewise takes on the nature of those around him, so he must be careful whom he chooses to follow.
The moth follows what it loves and becomes what it follows.
moth, choose company
My younger brother started hanging out with a rough group of friends and I've watched him change, like a moth drawn toward something that will burn him.
Sandalwood scents the beads that rest beside it; so the good perfume all who sit near.
beads, sandalwood, good company
Compose a doha about a string of prayer beads kept beside sandalwood that slowly takes on its fragrance, as a person takes on the goodness of those with whom he spends his days.
My grandmother keeps her prayer beads in a sandalwood box, and they smell lovely after all these years, and she always says it's the same for people.
doha: prayer beads next to sandalwood, you become your company
I started working in my friend's pottery workshop and his steady, disciplined way of living has slowly rubbed off on me.
Write a doha about how a lump of clay becomes a beautiful vessel in the hands of a skilled potter, the way a person is shaped by the company of wise and good friends.
Clay is shaped by the hands that hold it; so is the heart by the friends it keeps.
potter, clay, friends
doha: clay takes the potter's shape, we take our friends'
Since I moved into the dorm with the serious students my habits have changed dramatically, like a fish placed in a different stream that drifts in a new direction.
Compose a doha about a fish that swims where its companions swim, following the school into clear water or murky, showing that the company we keep leads us to the places we end up.
doha: fish follow the school, we follow our friends
The fish follows the fish, and goes where the stream goes; the heart follows the heart.
fish, company
moth, boat, good company
doha: moth on a boat, who you travel with matters
The moth on the boat goes where the boat goes; the soul where its company leads.
Write a doha about a moth riding on a boat, carried wherever the vessel goes, a reflection of how a person is carried toward good or evil by the company he travels with, whether he wishes it or not.
I'm just along for the ride with my friends' plans these days, like a moth on a boat, and I've started to worry about where they're taking me.

Compose a doha about a boat that carries each passenger to the same shore, whatever their differences, showing how those who travel together become alike, so we should choose carefully those we share a boat with.
On the ferry to my new college I sat with a group of cheerful, hard-working students, and four years later we're still the best of friends and all successful.
boat, good company
doha: choose who to share your boat with
Share the boat with the wise, and the far shore is near.

Write a doha about a string of prayer beads that holds its beads together in a shared line, a picture of friends in good company who keep one another steady on the way, and without whom each would roll away.
prayer beads, friends
doha: prayer beads need each other, like friends
I have a small group of friends who meet once a week to sit in silence and recite, with beads in hand, and I notice how much steadier I am since I joined.
Bead leans on bead along the string; so friends hold friends upon the way.

Please write a doha about how the company we keep slowly shapes our habits, thoughts and character, so that spending time with good people makes us better and spending time with bad ones makes us worse without our even noticing.
doha on choosing your friends wisely
My son has started coming home late and talking differently since he joined a new group of friends, and I'm worried about what influence they have.
Tell me who walks beside you and I will tell you where you are going.
good friends matter
doha: tree by the well grows well, like us with good company
The tree beside the well grows green; the heart beside the wise grows wise.
tree, well, company
My grandmother's tree by the well always flourished because of the water nearby, and I now think about how I flourished when I lived with kind relatives in the village.
Compose a doha about a tree growing beside a well, nourished by what is near it, a picture of how a person who lives close to the wise and the good takes strength and growth from them naturally.
doha: lamp lights other lamps, good friends
One lamp lights another and loses nothing; so the good are glad to share what they have.

Write a doha about a lamp that lights another lamp without losing its own flame, a picture of the good person who shares his goodness with those near him and is not diminished, but brightens the whole gathering.
lamp, good company
When I joined the study circle, a friend patiently shared everything he knew, and I felt as if I were a small lamp finally lit by a bigger one.
Compose a doha about how bad company drags a good person down while good company lifts even a weak person up, reminding us that choosing our friends is one of the most important choices we ever make.
doha about choosing good friends
I used to hang with a crowd that drank and gambled, and when I finally moved away and met calmer people, my whole life improved without my trying.
As you walk with the wise you grow wise, and with fools you learn to fall.
bad friends, good friends
boat, co-passengers
Write a doha about the people who share your boat on the crossing, showing that those who travel together share a fate, so we should be careful about whom we choose to board with.
doha: be careful who is in your boat
The boat is only as steady as those who sit in it.
My business partner and I have been in this together for ten years, and I've realised the quality of our decisions depends on who's beside me in the boat.
Compose a doha about sandalwood that gives its fragrance to everything near it, even common wood, showing that being near good people lifts and sweetens all who sit beside them.
sandalwood, company
doha: sandalwood scents the wood near it
I got a job at a sandalwood workshop run by a calm, generous old man, and after a year I notice I've become calmer and more generous without even trying.
Plain wood beside the sandalwood takes on its scent without a word.
potter, clay, friends
Under the potter's hand, the clay becomes a vessel; under good friends, a man becomes himself.
doha: potter and clay, we become who we're with
Write a doha about a potter whose hands shape the clay into a vessel of beauty and use, a picture of how a good friend or mentor shapes the people around him into the best version of themselves.
My best friend's family are all potters, and after years of being with them I've picked up their patience and quiet craftsmanship.
Many beads on one string make a strand of prayer; many good friends make one strong soul.
When my friends and I meet each Sunday to chant together with our prayer beads, each of us feels much more devoted than when we pray alone.
prayer beads, friends
doha: prayer beads strung together like good friends
Compose a doha about prayer beads gathered on a single string, no bead alone enough but all together forming a complete whole, a picture of how a community of good friends makes each member stronger.
doha: choose who goes in your boat
boat, fellow travellers
I just quit a group of friends who were bad for me, and it felt like getting off a leaking boat and onto a stronger one.

Write a doha about a person who steps from a boat full of troubled companions onto a sturdier boat with wiser company, knowing that the people who share our passage decide how safely we reach the shore.
A boat is guided by those who ride in it; choose your fellow travellers wisely.
Write a doha about sandalwood kept beside a well, whose fragrance sweetens even the water that rises from it, showing that the good people in a community improve the lives of everyone who draws near.
In my village there's an old man who lives beside the well and has sandalwood on his forehead, and everyone who spends time with him seems to come away a bit more thoughtful.
sandalwood, well, good people
doha: sandalwood by the well, good people improve the village
Sandalwood by the well, and even the water is sweeter; so one good man perfumes the village.
doha: prayer beads in the market, find like-minded friends
market, beads, good friends

Write a doha about a person who carries his prayer beads into the busy market and finds a few good friends there who share his faith, showing that even in noisy places, good company can keep the heart steady.
In the market's din, a few friends and a string of beads keep the soul in tune.
I started going to the market earlier than usual, because there's a small group of old gentlemen who meet there with their prayer beads, and I always feel calmer after talking with them.
My younger sister keeps going to parties with a crowd that glitters but is shallow, like a moth to a lamp, and I'm worried about her.
moth, lamp, choose carefully
The moth is drawn to the lamp that burns it; choose carefully whom you circle.

Compose a doha about a moth that circles a lamp thinking it a friend and is destroyed by it, a warning that not every attractive companion is a good one, and that we should choose whom we follow wisely.
doha: moth and lamp, beware of bad company
lamp, company of the wise
Write a doha about a small lamp that gains great brightness when it sits beside other lamps, a picture of a person who grows brighter in the company of wise and good people.
One lamp is small; a hundred together make the night day.
doha: many lamps together, good company
After joining a community of people who volunteer together every Sunday, I feel like a small lamp that's found other lamps.
Fellow travellers in the boat become one in fate; choose them as you would choose your shore.
Compose a doha about a boat on a long crossing in which all the passengers share the same fate, and about how the company on board shapes the whole journey, for better or worse.
boat, company
doha: good company in a boat
On a long ferry ride last month I ended up sitting with a group of wise old travellers, and the conversations changed how I think about my own life.
doha: potter and clay, shaped by company
potter, clay, company
Write a doha about a lump of clay on the potter's wheel, which becomes whatever the potter's hands make it, a picture of how a person becomes the product of the company he keeps.
The clay becomes what the potter's hands intend; the heart becomes what its friends are.
Growing up in my uncle's pottery workshop with such hardworking people, I became diligent without being told to be.
The boat is no better than its crew; choose the wise to row beside you.
doha: choosing your crew on the boat
boat, crew, company
In my last job the team was toxic, and everything felt like I was in a sinking boat; a new team of kind colleagues transformed it.
Write a doha about the importance of choosing the right company on a boat journey, for the wise crew will steer to safe harbour while a careless crew will bring everyone to ruin.
doha: market, who you hang out with

Compose a doha about a person in the busy market who chooses to walk beside the honest and generous merchants rather than the cheats, showing that the company we keep in the world determines the person we become.
In the market of friends, choose those whose goodness is not for sale.
market, friends
I used to work with shady traders in the market, but when I moved to a stall beside an honest old man I found my whole attitude changing.
need a doha: friends matter a lot
friends shape you
Write a doha about how the people we spend time with quietly shape our values, our habits and our dreams, so that one wise friend can change a whole life, and one careless friend can undo it.
I was an aimless drifter until I met two friends in college who actually cared about doing something with their lives, and now I can't imagine who I'd be without them.
The company you keep is the mirror you carry; look, and see who you are becoming.
When I moved to a new city I fell in with a wonderful group of people, and I realised that I'm much calmer and kinder than I was a year ago.
the right people
Where the wise gather, even the foolish begin to learn.

Please write a doha about the quiet power of good company, how simply sitting with kind, honest and thoughtful people can transform us without any effort, and how every wise friend is a gift worth treasuring.
doha: hanging out with good people improves you
Last summer I took a boat trip with kind, cheerful travellers, and one of them kept a little lamp lit each night, and by the end I felt I'd become a better person just from being around them.
A lamp in the boat, good friends beside you; the night crossing is a joy.
Write a doha about a boat on a dark river with a single lamp and a handful of kind fellow travellers, showing that good company turns even a dark crossing into a safe and happy journey.
boat, lamp, friends
doha: lamp in the boat, kind companions
Tree and potter, side by side: one gives shade, the other gives form, and I am made by both.
doha: a potter and a tree, my good friends shape me
I grew up between a potter's workshop and the big tree in the yard where the elders sat, and I think those two places made me who I am.
tree, potter, good company

Compose a doha about a person who spends his days between the potter's workshop and the shade of a great tree, shaped by the company of makers and elders, becoming wise and gentle without ever being told to.
In a good boat with good companions, even the stormy crossing is sweet.
My best friends and I once got caught in a storm on a boat trip and, because of how we looked after each other, it turned out to be the best day of our lives.
Write a doha about a group of friends in a boat who care for one another through a rough crossing, showing that good companions turn hardship into something sweet and make the journey worth taking.
boat, friends
doha: good friends in a boat, everything is okay
doha: fish takes on the water it lives in, like us and our friends
I've noticed that my cousin who moved abroad speaks and thinks like his new friends now, like a fish that has changed waters.
The fish becomes the water it swims in, and the man the company he keeps.
fish, company
Compose a doha about a fish that takes on the character of the water in which it lives, clear or muddy, a reminder that our surroundings and companions slowly shape who we are.
Write a doha about the way bad company can corrupt even a good person and good company can lift even the weak, reminding us to be careful whom we befriend since friendship shapes destiny.
I stopped hanging out with a group of friends who always mocked others, and within months I noticed I was kinder and happier in myself.
Walk beside the good, and your steps grow right without a word of advice.
choose friends wisely
doha: avoid bad company
company shapes character
After my friend circle changed in college, my goals, my habits and even my sense of humor changed, and I think I owe my whole life to that.
doha about how friends change you
Compose a doha about how the people we sit with become part of our own thoughts and habits, so that we should take as much care in choosing our companions as in choosing our own path through life.
Not by teaching but by being near, the good make good of all around them.
My teacher the potter always sat with his students under the old tree in the evening, and they all grew up gentle and wise, just like him.

Write a doha about a potter who sits with his students under a tree in the evening, shaping young minds as he shapes clay, showing that the company of a wise teacher forms the character of those near him.
potter, tree, good company
doha: students with a potter under a tree
Under the tree the potter sits with his students, and clay and character both take form.
doha: prayer beads and sandalwood, good friends rub off on you
Sandalwood and beads, both quietly shared among friends, scent every heart they touch.
My friends and I trade sandalwood paste and prayer beads at our weekly gathering, and I've noticed we all treat people better since we started.

Write a doha about a circle of friends who share prayer beads and sandalwood in their weekly gathering, each leaving more fragrant in spirit than he came, because good company perfumes every soul it touches.
beads, sandalwood, friends
doha: moth drawn to sandalwood, good company draws good people
Compose a doha about a moth that settles on sandalwood and carries its fragrance away, a picture of the way even a casual visitor is changed by time spent with a good and gentle person.
The moth that rests on sandalwood carries its scent into the night.
moth, sandalwood, good friends
My cousin visited our grandfather for just one summer, a restless kid like a moth, and came back smelling of sandalwood and talking like a sage.
One lamp can light a thousand more and lose nothing; the good give and are never poorer.
Compose a doha about a lamp lighting other lamps in a dark room, a picture of how one good person spreads wisdom to those around him, and how company with such a person makes everyone brighter.
At our community gathering every evening, a retired teacher lights a lamp and everyone else lights theirs from his, and I swear the room feels warmer for it.
lamp, good company
doha: lamp lighting lamps, good people
I joined a rowing club with disciplined and cheerful people, and each morning in our boat I feel myself getting better than I was.
boat, crew

Compose a doha about a boat crew who row together in harmony, each lifting the others and keeping the pace, showing how good company makes everyone stronger and the journey lighter than any one could manage alone.
doha: rowing with good crew
In a boat of good friends, each oar is helped by the others.
My grandfather's fishing friends all gathered under the old tree each evening to talk, and every one of them grew wise and kind through the years of that company.

Write a doha about fishermen who gather under a tree each evening to share stories, becoming wiser and kinder through the years in each other's company, a picture of how good friends lift one another.
Under the tree the fishermen gather, and the catch of the day is only the lesser gift.
fish, tree, friends
doha: fishermen under a tree, good company
Compose a doha about a lamp and a string of prayer beads in a gathering of friends, each steady in its place, showing that devotion and light are multiplied when good people share them together.
Lamp and beads in the circle of friends, and the night itself becomes a prayer.
lamp, beads, good friends
Every Thursday evening our little group sits together with a lamp and our prayer beads, and I swear I've become a better version of myself since I joined.
doha: lamp and beads in a good group
doha: moth + boat + friendly travellers
moth, boat, kind travellers
Write a doha about a moth that rides a boat with a company of friendly travellers, safe and carried gently across the water, showing that even the smallest soul finds protection in good company.
The little moth finds shelter in the boat of the kind.
A tiny moth rode with us on our ferry across the lake, and I noticed how the group of strangers around me seemed to look out for each other like family.
doha: lamp in the market, good company
In the market's din, a lamp among friends is the home of the heart.

Write a doha about a lamp burning in the market at night in the company of a few honest friends, who share their warmth with passers-by, showing that goodness gathers goodness even in the busiest places.
market, lamp, friends
My uncle and his friends have a little tea stall in the market with a lamp that burns all night, and people from all over come just to sit with them.
I've noticed that I'm a different person around my best friend than around my other group, and I'm trying to figure out which one I want to be.

Compose a doha about how we become different people in different company, and about how the wise choose to spend their time with those who bring out their best qualities, since that is who we eventually become.
doha about picking the right friends
the company you keep
Show me your friends and I will show you your future.
doha: lamp and good company
lamp, wise friends
Write a doha about a person who sits near a lamp in the company of wise friends, whose conversation brightens the mind as the lamp brightens the room, and who leaves each time a little wiser.
The lamp brightens the room, the friend brightens the mind; both are gifts of the evening.
Our evening group of friends always sits by one small lamp, and I find myself thinking more clearly after being around them.

Compose a doha about a lamp under a tree that draws a gathering of kind people to sit together, showing that where good company meets, even the quietest evening becomes a place of learning and warmth.
In our village, the elders light a lamp under the big tree each evening, and the youngsters come to sit with them, and I can see the effect on every child who grows up there.
Lamp beneath the tree, and good people gathered; here the village learns its goodness.
lamp, tree, wise friends
doha: lamp under a tree, wise friends
Write a doha about a moth that follows the best of its companions rather than the flashiest, a picture of how the wise person chooses the friends whose influence will lift him instead of burn him.
moth, choose wisely
doha: moth chooses its friends
I used to chase every exciting party like a moth, but now I spend my time with a quiet group of steady friends and I've never felt better.
The wise moth follows the steady friend, not the dazzling one.
The potter's wheel turns, and clay becomes what company makes it; be careful whom you spin beside.
My uncle's pottery workshop was full of kind, patient people, and I realise now that the clay wasn't the only thing being shaped there.
doha: potter's workshop, kind people shape you
potter, company
Compose a doha about a pottery workshop full of kind people where the clay is shaped alongside the characters of those who work in it, showing that good company is a workshop for the soul.
Write a doha about a fish carried along by the school around it into clear waters or into danger, a reflection of how a person is led by those he swims with, for better or for worse.
The fish swims where the school swims, and so goes the heart among its friends.
I used to follow my friends into every bad decision, like a fish in a school, and only after I found new friends did I find my own direction.
doha: swimming with the right school of fish
fish, company
